instruction:
You are a senior geotechnical engineer specializing in retaining wall design.

## Problem

Calculate the active and passive lateral earth pressure coefficients and forces acting on a retaining wall using {{ theory | capitalize }} theory.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Wall height (H) | {{ wall_height_m }} | m |
{% if friction_angle_deg is defined %}
| Effective friction angle (φ') | {{ friction_angle_deg }} | degrees |
{% endif %}
{% if cohesion_kpa is defined %}
| Effective cohesion (c') | {{ cohesion_kpa }} | kPa |
{% endif %}
{% if unit_weight_kn_m3 is defined %}
| Soil unit weight (γ) | {{ unit_weight_kn_m3 }} | kN/m³ |
{% endif %}
{% if backfill_slope_deg is defined %}
| Backfill slope angle (β) | {{ backfill_slope_deg }} | degrees |
{% endif %}
{% if wall_friction_angle_deg is defined %}
| Wall friction angle (δ) | {{ wall_friction_angle_deg }} | degrees |
{% endif %}
{% if surcharge_kpa is defined %}
| Uniform surcharge (q) | {{ surcharge_kpa }} | kPa |
{% endif %}
| Theory | {{ theory }} | - |
{% if archetype_description is defined %}

### Site Conditions

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A lateral earth pressure calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Active earth pressure coefficient Ka
2. Passive earth pressure coefficient Kp
3. Active pressure at the base of the wall σ_a (kPa)
4. Passive pressure at the base of the wall σ_p (kPa)
5. Total active force per unit wall length Pa (kN/m)
6. Total passive force per unit wall length Pp (kN/m)
7. Point of application of the active force above the base (m)

## Applicable Standards

- Rankine, W.J.M. (1857) — On the Stability of Loose Earth
- Coulomb, C.A. (1776) — Essai sur une application des règles de maximis et minimis

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use the specified theory ({{ theory }}) for calculating earth pressure coefficients.
- **Rankine theory** (horizontal backfill):
  - Ka = tan²(45° − φ'/2)
  - Kp = tan²(45° + φ'/2)
- **Rankine theory** (inclined backfill with slope β):
  - Ka = cosβ × (cosβ − √(cos²β − cos²φ')) / (cosβ + √(cos²β − cos²φ'))
  - Kp = cosβ × (cosβ + √(cos²β − cos²φ')) / (cosβ − √(cos²β − cos²φ'))
- **Coulomb theory** (vertical wall, wall friction δ, backfill slope β):
  - Ka = cos²φ' / [cosδ × (1 + √(sin(φ'+δ)×sin(φ'−β) / (cosδ × cosβ)))²]
  - Kp = cos²φ' / [cosδ × (1 − √(sin(φ'−δ)×sin(φ'+β) / (cosδ × cosβ)))²]
- **Active pressure at depth z:** σ_a = Ka × γ × z + Ka × q − 2c'√Ka
- **Passive pressure at depth z:** σ_p = Kp × γ × z + Kp × q + 2c'√Kp
- **Total active force:** Pa = 0.5 × Ka × γ × H² + Ka × q × H − 2c'√Ka × H
- **Total passive force:** Pp = 0.5 × Kp × γ × H² + Kp × q × H + 2c'√Kp × H
- If total active force is negative (cohesion dominates), report Pa = 0
- Point of application is computed from the moment equilibrium of the pressure components
- For φ' = 0 (purely cohesive soil): Ka = Kp = 1.0

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including formulas and intermediate calculations. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "ka": <numeric_value>,
  "kp": <numeric_value>,
  "active_pressure_at_base_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "passive_pressure_at_base_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "total_active_force_kn_m": <numeric_value>,
  "total_passive_force_kn_m": <numeric_value>,
  "active_force_application_point_m": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "lateral-earth-pressure"
description = "Active and passive earth pressures using Rankine or Coulomb theory"
long_description = "Calculates active and passive earth pressure coefficients, base pressures, and total lateral forces on retaining walls using either Rankine or Coulomb theory. Supports inclined backfill, wall friction, cohesive soils, and uniform surcharge loading, computing the pressure distribution, total force per unit wall length, and the point of application for structural design of retaining structures."
discipline = "ground"
category = "retaining-walls"
standards = ["Rankine (1857)", "Coulomb (1776)"]
tags = ["geotechnical", "earth-pressure", "retaining-wall", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "both"

[params.friction_angle_deg]
type = "float"
unit = "degrees"
description = "Effective friction angle φ'"
min = 0
max = 45
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.cohesion_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "Effective cohesion c'"
min = 0
max = 100
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.unit_weight_kn_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kN/m³"
description = "Soil unit weight γ"
min = 14
max = 22
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.wall_height_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Retaining wall height H"
min = 1.5
max = 12.0

[params.backfill_slope_deg]
type = "float"
unit = "degrees"
description = "Backfill slope angle β above horizontal"
min = 0
max = 30
optional = true
default = 0.0

[params.wall_friction_angle_deg]
type = "float"
unit = "degrees"
description = "Wall friction angle δ (Coulomb theory)"
min = 0
max = 30
optional = true
default = 0.0

[params.surcharge_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "Uniform surcharge on backfill surface q"
min = 0
max = 50
optional = true
default = 0.0

[params.theory]
type = "enum"
description = "Earth pressure theory to apply"
values = ["rankine", "coulomb"]
default = "rankine"

[outputs.ka]
description = "Active earth pressure coefficient Ka"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.kp]
description = "Passive earth pressure coefficient Kp"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.active_pressure_at_base_kpa]
description = "Active pressure at base of wall σ_a (kPa)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.passive_pressure_at_base_kpa]
description = "Passive pressure at base of wall σ_p (kPa)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_active_force_kn_m]
description = "Total active force per unit wall length Pa (kN/m)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_passive_force_kn_m]
description = "Total passive force per unit wall length Pp (kN/m)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.active_force_application_point_m]
description = "Active force point of application above base (m)"
tolerance = 0.05

# --- Archetypes ---

[archetypes.loose_sand]
description = "Loose sand backfill"
friction_angle_deg = {min = 28, max = 32}
cohesion_kpa = {min = 0, max = 0}
unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 15, max = 17}
site_contexts = ["perth-coastal", "hunter-valley-alluvial"]

[archetypes.medium_dense_sand]
description = "Medium dense sand backfill"
friction_angle_deg = {min = 32, max = 36}
cohesion_kpa = {min = 0, max = 0}
unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 17, max = 19}
site_contexts = ["sydney-harbour", "brisbane-river"]

[archetypes.dense_sand_gravel]
description = "Dense sand and gravel backfill"
friction_angle_deg = {min = 36, max = 42}
cohesion_kpa = {min = 0, max = 0}
unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 19, max = 21}
site_contexts = ["cairns-coral", "adelaide-quarry"]

[archetypes.stiff_clay]
description = "Stiff clay backfill"
friction_angle_deg = {min = 18, max = 25}
cohesion_kpa = {min = 20, max = 60}
unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 18, max = 21}
site_contexts = ["melbourne-basalt", "sydney-hawkesbury"]

[archetypes.soft_clay]
description = "Soft normally consolidated clay"
friction_angle_deg = {min = 10, max = 18}
cohesion_kpa = {min = 5, max = 20}
unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 15, max = 17}
site_contexts = ["darwin-estuarine", "brisbane-alluvial"]

# --- Difficulty levels ---

[difficulty.easy]
description = "Rankine theory, horizontal backfill, cohesionless soil, no surcharge"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["loose_sand", "medium_dense_sand"]
theory = ["rankine"]
backfill_slope_deg = [0.0]
wall_friction_angle_deg = [0.0]
surcharge_kpa = [0.0]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "Rankine with inclined backfill or cohesive soil, surcharge may be present"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["loose_sand", "medium_dense_sand", "dense_sand_gravel", "stiff_clay"]
theory = ["rankine"]
wall_friction_angle_deg = [0.0]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Coulomb theory with wall friction, some soil parameters hidden"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["cohesion_kpa", "friction_angle_deg", "unit_weight_kn_m3"]
replacement_text = "The retained soil is {{ archetype.description }} ({{ archetype.site_context }})"
archetypes = ["medium_dense_sand", "dense_sand_gravel", "stiff_clay", "soft_clay"]
theory = ["coulomb"]
